scope: Local single-request tests on this exact quantized 1017 checkpoint; no general quality benchmark claim.
heldout_prompts: Frozen before sweep completion and before profile selection; synthetic repeated-context throughput workloads.
sampling: temperature 1, top_p 1; deterministic per-repeat seed; compare identical prompt hashes.
kernel_primary: Token-identical candidate using the existing arithmetic for rows 1..5; six-row fallback change reported separately.
quality: Eight local programming tasks, 160 deterministic hidden cases each; greedy generation, no imports/classes; stop normally at EOS.
long_context: Separate retrieval capability checks, not an aggregate quality benchmark.
honesty: Discard forced-length runs with early EOS from speed summaries; report failures and unchanged/different token streams.
